# SwifWire — context for LLMs / server agents

> Use this file as system/context bootstrap. Prefer JSON Schema under /schema over inventing fields.
> Human index: docs/INDEX.md

## What this project is

SwifWire = custom tunnel protocol for SwifTun.
Stack: Mask (wire appearance) || Session (Noise_IK-like X25519 + ChaCha20-Poly1305 AEAD + stream mux + datagram).
NOT Xray protocol. NOT WireGuard. Edge runs as sidecar binary `swif-edge` (3x-ui MTProto pattern).
Client embeds `swif-core` / `swifwire.dll` and exposes local SOCKS5; each CONNECT dials the edge.

## Current version

See VERSION file (commercial Windows pack 0.2.x). Default mask = tls13_stable.

## Binaries

- swif-edge.exe — node/server
- swif-core-run.exe — client core (config JSON path arg)
- swif-cli.exe — lab SOCKS client
- swif-tray.exe — start/stop wrapper around swif-core-run
- swifwire.dll + include/swifwire.h — C ABI

## Subscription URI (canonical)

```
swif://HOST:PORT?pub=HEX64&mask=tls13_stable&sni=cdn.example.com
```

- pub: server static public key, 64 lowercase/upper hex chars (32 bytes)
- mask: null_tcp | tls13_stable | quic_fast
- sni: optional cover SNI for tls13_stable

## Client core config (flat JSON accepted by swif_core_start / swif-core-run)

Required (flat form):
- server_addr: "host:port"
- server_static_pub_hex: 64 hex
Optional:
- mask_profile: default tls13_stable
- socks_listen: default 127.0.0.1:10808
- tls_material_path: path to lab/prod TLS material JSON for tls13_stable (cert_hex, key_hex, sni)
- start_runtime: bool, default true (false = config only, no SOCKS)
- route_mode: "global" | others string (stored; routing policy evolving)
- pack_trust_pub_hex: ed25519 trust for mask packs

Also accepts nested `outbound` object matching schema/outbound.v1.json.

Validate with: schema/core-config.v1.json

## Panel inbound

protocol MUST be "swifwire". See schema/inbound.v1.json and deploy/inbound.example.json.
Supervisor starts: swif-edge --listen LISTEN:PORT --key server.key --pub-out server.pub --mask MASK [--sni] [--cover]

## C ABI (stable surface)

From include/swifwire.h:
- swif_abi_version, swif_version, swif_string_free
- swif_core_start(config_json, &err)
- swif_core_stop()
- swif_core_set_route_mode(mode, &err)
- swif_core_import_subscription(url_or_blob, &err)
- swif_core_apply_mask_pack(bytes, len, &err)
- swif_core_status_alloc(&err) → JSON schema/core-status.v1.json
- swif_core_outbound_alloc(&err)
- swif_panel_edge_argv_alloc(inbound_json, &err)
- swif_panel_share_uri_alloc(inbound_json, public_host, server_pub_hex, remark, &err)

Free every allocated char* with swif_string_free.

## Security / ops rules for agents

1. Never put server.key in client configs, git, or chat logs.
2. Do not enable null_tcp on public nodes unless SWIF_ALLOW_NULL=1 intentionally (lab only).
3. Prefer tls13_stable + real cover domain/cert in production.
4. Prod tls13_stable edge REQUIRES --cover/--cover-upstream OR SWIF_LAB=1 (builtin HTML is lab-only).
5. Prefer --tls-cert/--tls-key PEM for prod; JSON lab-cert.der.json is lab.
6. Handshake is SwifHS v0 (not Noise_IK). See docs/WIRE.md §4 and docs/HARDENING.md.
7. quic_fast == quic_lab thin cover — not prod default.
8. After changing inbound, restart swif-edge sidecar; republish swif:// with new pub if key rotated.
9. Smoke: scripts/smoke-all.ps1 (sets SWIF_LAB=1). Release: scripts/release-win.ps1.

## Hardening status

Read docs/HARDENING.md.
Done: SwifHS v0, resume_fs, cover mirror, PEM, SWIF_LAB, tls_verify pin|webpki, shaper idle, DialPolicy (tls-sticky), smoke-probe-cover, pack ALPN hints, quic_lab grease, quic_stable scaffold, legacy_fallback_uri.
Open: full uTLS JA3/JA4, quinn quic_stable runtime, host-app legacy dialer.

## Dual-stack (phase 1)

Config field `legacy_fallback_uri` (opaque string). SwifWire does NOT dial it. On TLS dial exhaustion core errors with `legacy_fallback_hint=…` for the VPN UI to switch.

## Go panel helpers

Package: bindings/go/swifwire
- EdgeArgv(inbound) []string
- ShareURI(host, port, pubHex, mask, sni) string
- Supervisor{EdgeBin, WorkDir}.Start/Stop

## What NOT to invent

- Do not invent VLESS/Reality UUIDs for SwifWire.
- Do not claim OS TUN is default — SOCKS is the supported product path; os-tun is optional feature.
- quic_fast SOCKS path in core may be incomplete; prefer tls13_stable for production clients.
- XHTTP is NOT implemented yet; may become a future mask pack — do not emit xhttp configs.

## Example minimal client config

```json
{
  "server_addr": "vpn.example.com:443",
  "server_static_pub_hex": "REPLACE_WITH_64_HEX_SERVER_PUB",
  "mask_profile": "tls13_stable",
  "socks_listen": "127.0.0.1:10808",
  "tls_material_path": "lab-cert.der.json",
  "start_runtime": true,
  "route_mode": "global"
}
```

## Example share

```
swif://vpn.example.com:443?pub=ab…64hex…&mask=tls13_stable&sni=cdn.example.com
```
